loose_belt.summary: Excessive belt sag detected between pulleys, indicating insufficient tension which may lead to slippage and reduced pump efficiency.

repair_steps.title: Safety Lockout
repair_steps.instruction: Shut down the motor and implement lock-out/tag-out procedures to ensure the pump cannot be started.
repair_steps.warning: Severe injury risk if machine starts during inspection.

repair_steps.title: Belt Inspection
repair_steps.instruction: Examine the belt for glazing, cracking, or permanent stretching.

repair_steps.title: Adjust Tension
repair_steps.instruction: Loosen the motor mounting bolts and slide the motor base to increase tension on the belt span.
repair_steps.warning: Avoid over-tensioning to prevent premature bearing failure.

repair_steps.title: Tension Verification
repair_steps.instruction: Check deflection at the center of the span; it should meet the manufacturer's specified deflection limit.

repair_steps.title: Secure and Test
repair_steps.instruction: Tighten all mounting hardware and reinstall safety guards before performing a test run.
repair_steps.warning: Ensure all guards are secure to prevent debris ingress.

stop_conditions: Belt is stretched beyond maximum adjustment limit
Pulley misalignment detected that prevents proper seating
Severe belt fraying or structural failure observed

worn_belt.summary: Drive belt exhibits significant fraying and glazing on the contact surfaces, indicating imminent failure and reduced pumping efficiency.

repair_steps.title: Power Isolation
repair_steps.instruction: Disconnect the pump from the primary power source and apply lockout-tagout (LOTO) procedures.
repair_steps.warning: Failure to isolate power may result in accidental startup and severe injury.

repair_steps.title: Tension Release
repair_steps.instruction: Loosen the motor mounting bolts to slide the motor away from the pump, releasing tension on the belt.

repair_steps.title: Belt Removal and Pulley Inspection
repair_steps.instruction: Remove the worn belt and inspect both the drive and driven pulleys for scoring, wear, or misalignment.
repair_steps.warning: Replace pulleys if deep grooves are detected to prevent premature wear of the new belt.

repair_steps.title: Installation
repair_steps.instruction: Install a new belt matching the original OEM specifications and adjust motor position to achieve proper tension.

repair_steps.title: Validation Run
repair_steps.instruction: Tighten all mounting bolts, remove LOTO devices, and run the pump for 5 minutes to verify smooth operation.
repair_steps.warning: Ensure all guards are reinstalled before powering on.

stop_conditions: Pulley shaft is bent or excessively worn
Belt slippage persists after proper tensioning
Abnormal vibration detected during validation run

misaligned_belt.summary: Drive belt is tracking off-center on the pulleys, leading to uneven edge wear and risk of belt slippage.

repair_steps.title: Safety Lockout
repair_steps.instruction: Disconnect the power source and implement lockout-tagout procedures to ensure the pump cannot start.
repair_steps.warning: Verify zero energy state before touching the drive system.

repair_steps.title: Check Pulley Parallelism
repair_steps.instruction: Use a straight edge or laser alignment tool across the faces of both pulleys to identify the degree of misalignment.

repair_steps.title: Adjust Pulley Alignment
repair_steps.instruction: Loosen the pulley mounting bolts and shift the pulley until it is perfectly aligned with the mating pulley.
repair_steps.warning: Do not force the pulley; check for debris on the shaft first.

repair_steps.title: Tension Adjustment
repair_steps.instruction: Re-tension the belt to the manufacturer's specification using the tensioning bolt or slider.
repair_steps.warning: Excessive tension can lead to premature bearing failure.

repair_steps.title: Operational Test
repair_steps.instruction: Remove guards, start the pump briefly to observe tracking, then reinstall all safety guards.
repair_steps.warning: Never observe the belt without safety guards in place during full operation.

stop_conditions: Belt continues to track off-center after two adjustment attempts
Evidence of pulley shaft bending or wear
Belt displays deep structural cracks or fraying
